40022878.author: पदार्थः
40022878.content: तौ they both, रजन्यां in the night, प्रभातायां when it dawned, स्नातौ having bathed, हुतहुताशनौ having offered oblations to the fire, यथोक्तम् as narrated, ऋषिणा by the sage, पूर्वं previously, सर्वं all, तत्र there, उपगायताम् they sang.

40022878.author: Translation
40022878.content: When the night dawned, after bathing and performing their fire oblations, the two boys sang the entire Ramayana as previously narrated by the sage Valmiki in that assembly.

40022879.author: पदार्थः
40022879.content: ताम् that, सः he, शुश्राव heard, काकुत्स्थः Rama, पूर्वाचार्यविजिर्मिताम् composed by the ancient preceptor, अपूर्वाम् unprecedented, पाठ्यजातिं type of recitation, च and, गेयेन with melody, समलङ्कृताम् adorned.

40022879.author: Translation
40022879.content: Rama heard that unique form of recitation, composed by the ancient preceptor Valmiki, which was embellished with melody.

40022880.author: पदार्थः
40022880.content: प्रमाणैः with many measures, बहुभिः many, बद्धां structured, तन्त्रीलयसमन्विताम् accompanied by string instruments and rhythm, बालाभ्यां from the two boys, राघवः Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौतूहलपरः filled with curiosity, अभवत् became.

40022880.author: Translation
40022880.content: Having heard the recitation, which was structured with many meters and accompanied by string instruments and rhythm, from the two boys, Rama became extremely curious.

40022881.author: पदार्थः
40022881.content: अथ then, कर्मान्तरे at the end of the ritual, राजा the king, समाहूय having summoned, महामुनीन् great sages, पार्थिवाम् kings, च and, नरव्याघ्रः the tiger among men, पण्डितान् scholars, नैगमान् citizens, तथा also.

40022881.author: Translation
40022881.content: Then, during a break in the ceremony, King Rama, the tiger among men, summoned great sages, other kings, scholars, and citizens.

40022882.author: पदार्थः
40022882.content: पौराणिकाञ् those learned in Puranas, शब्दविदः grammarians, ये who, च and, वृद्धाः elderly, द्विजातयः Brahmins, स्वराणां of musical notes, लक्षणज्ञान् experts, च and, उत्सुकान् eager, द्विजसत्तमान् excellent Brahmins.

40022882.author: Translation
40022882.content: He also summoned those learned in Puranas, grammarians, elderly Brahmins, experts in musical notes, and other eager, excellent Brahmins.

40022883.author: पदार्थः
40022883.content: लक्षणज्ञान् those who know characteristics, च and, गान्धर्वान् those skilled in music, नैगमान् those skilled in Vedas, च and, विशेषतः especially, पादाक्षरसमासज्ञान् those who know feet, syllables, and compounds, छन्दःसु in prosody, परिनिष्ठितान् well-versed.

40022883.author: Translation
40022883.content: He gathered those who were knowledgeable in characteristics, skilled in music, especially proficient in the Vedas, and well-versed in the intricacies of prosody, including feet, syllables, and compounds.

40022884.author: पदार्थः
40022884.content: कलामात्राविशेषज्ञान् those who know the distinctions of arts and measures, ज्योतिषे in astronomy, च and, परं highest, गतान attained, क्रियाकल्पविदः those who know rituals and procedures, च and, एव indeed, तथा similarly, कार्यविदः those who know actions, जनान् people.

40022884.author: Translation
40022884.content: He also gathered people who were experts in the nuances of arts and measures, highly proficient in astronomy, knowledgeable in rituals and procedures, and skilled in practical affairs.

40022885.author: पदार्थः
40022885.content: भाषाज्ञान् those who know languages, इङ्गितज्ञान् those who know gestures, च and, नैगमान् those skilled in Vedas, च and, अपि also, अशेषतः completely, हेतूपचारकुशलान् those skilled in reasoning and application, वचने in speech, च and, अपि also, हैतुकान् logicians.

40022885.author: Translation
40022885.content: He assembled those who were proficient in languages, understood gestures, were completely knowledgeable in the Vedas, skilled in reasoning and its application, and adept logicians in speech.

40022886.author: पदार्थः
40022886.content: छन्दोविदः those who know prosody, पुराणज्ञान् those who know Puranas, वैदिकान् those who know Vedas, द्विजसत्तमान् best among Brahmins, चित्रज्ञान् those who know painting, वृत्तसूत्रज्ञान् those who know conduct and aphorisms, गीतनृत्यविशारदान् those skilled in singing and dancing.

40022886.author: Translation
40022886.content: He gathered the best among Brahmins who were experts in prosody, Puranas, and Vedas, along with those skilled in painting, conduct, aphorisms, singing, and dancing.

40022887.author: पदार्थः
40022887.content: शास्त्रज्ञान् those who know scriptures, नीतिनिपुणान् those skilled in ethics, वेदान्तार्थप्रबोधकान् those who enlighten on the meaning of Vedanta, एतान् these, सर्वान् all, समानीय having assembled, गातारौ the two singers, समवेशयत् he seated.

40022887.author: Translation
40022887.content: Having assembled all these individuals who were knowledgeable in scriptures, skilled in ethics, and capable of explaining the meaning of Vedanta, he then seated the two singers (Lava and Kusha) among them.

40022888.author: पदार्थः
40022888.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, मुनिगणाः groups of sages, सर्वे all, पार्थिवाश्च and kings, महौजसः of great might, पिबन्त इव as if drinking, चक्षुर्भ्यां with their eyes, राजानं the king (Rama), गायकौ the two singers, च and, तौ those two

40022888.author: Translation
40022888.content: All the sages and mighty kings, having seen the king and those two singers, were as if drinking them in with their eyes.

40022889.author: पदार्थः
40022889.content: ऊचुः they said, परस्परं to each other, च and, इदं this, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समन्ततः from all sides, उभौ both, रामस्य of Rama, सदृशौ similar, बिम्बात् from an image, बिम्बमिव like an image, उत्थितौ arisen

40022889.author: Translation
40022889.content: All of them, from all sides, said this to each other: "Both are similar to Rama, as if one image has arisen from another."

40022890.author: पदार्थः
40022890.content: जटिलौ having matted hair, यदि if, न स्यातां they were not, न not, वल्कलधरौ wearing bark garments, यदि if, विशेषं difference, न not, अधिगच्छामः we would perceive, गायतोः between the two singers, राघवस्य of Rama, च and

40022890.author: Translation
40022890.content: If they did not have matted hair and were not wearing bark garments, we would not perceive any difference between the two singers and Rama.

40022891.author: पदार्थः
40022891.content: तेषां of them, संवदतां conversing, एवं thus, श्रोतऽणां of the listeners, हर्षवर्धनम् increasing joy, गेयं the song, प्रचक्रतुः they performed, तत्र there, तौ those, उभौ two, मुनिदारकौ sons of the sage

40022891.author: Translation
40022891.content: While they were conversing thus, those two sons of the sage performed the song there, which increased the joy of the listeners.

40022892.author: पदार्थः
40022892.content: ततः then, प्रवृत्तं commenced, मधुरं sweet, गान्धर्वं music (Gandharva style), अतिमानुषम् superhuman, न not, च and, तृप्तिं satisfaction, ययुः they attained, सर्वे all, श्रोतारः listeners, गानसम्पदा from the richness of the song

40022892.author: Translation
40022892.content: Then commenced the sweet, superhuman Gandharva music, and all the listeners could not get enough of the richness of the song.

40022893.author: पदार्थः
40022893.content: प्रवृत्तम् begun, आदितः from the beginning, पूर्वसर्गम् the first canto, नारददर्शितम् revealed by Narada, ततः then, प्रभृति onwards, सर्गांश्च and the cantos, यावत् up to, विंशति twenty, अगायताम् they sang.

40022893.author: Translation
40022893.content: They sang the Ramayana, starting from the first canto revealed by Narada, and continued singing up to the twentieth canto.

40022894.author: पदार्थः
40022894.content: ततः then, अपराह्णसमये in the afternoon time, राघवः Rama, समभाषत spoke, श्रुत्वा having heard, विंशतिसर्गांस्तान् those twenty cantos, भ्रातरं to his brother, भ्रातृवत्सलः affectionate towards his brothers.

40022894.author: Translation
40022894.content: After hearing those twenty cantos, Rama, who was affectionate towards his brothers, spoke to his brother in the afternoon.

40022895.author: पदार्थः
40022895.content: अष्टादशसहस्राणि eighteen thousand, सुवर्णस्य of gold, महात्मनोः to the great-souled ones, प्रयच्छ give, शीघ्रं quickly, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, यत् whatever, अन्यत् other, अभिकाङ्क्षितम् is desired; ददौ he gave, शीघ्रं quickly, स he, काकुत्स्थो Kakutstha, बालयोर्वै to the two boys indeed, पृथक्पृथक् separately.

40022895.author: Translation
40022895.content: Rama instructed his brother, "O Kakutstha, quickly give eighteen thousand gold coins to these great-souled ones, and whatever else they desire," and his brother promptly gave the two boys their shares separately.

40022896.author: पदार्थः
40022896.content: दीयमानं being given, सुवर्णं gold, तु but, नागृह्णीतां did not accept, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, ऊचतुश्च and they said, महात्मानौ the two great-souled ones, किम् what, अनेन with this, इति thus, विस्मितौ astonished.

40022896.author: Translation
40022896.content: But Kusha and Lava, the two great-souled boys, did not accept the gold being offered, and astonished, they asked, "What shall we do with this?"

40022897.author: पदार्थः
40022897.content: वन्येन with forest produce, फलमूलेन with fruits and roots, निरतौ content, वनवासिनौ we two forest dwellers, सुवर्णेन with gold, हिरण्येन with gold, किं what, करिष्यावहे shall we do, वने in the forest.

40022897.author: Translation
40022897.content: As forest dwellers content with forest produce, fruits, and roots, they questioned what they would do with gold in the forest.

40022898.author: पदार्थः
40022898.content: तथा thus, तयोः of those two, प्रब्रुवतोः while speaking, कौतूहलसमन्विताः filled with curiosity, श्रोतारः the listeners, च and, एव indeed, रामः Rama, च and, सर्व all, एव indeed, सुविस्मिताः greatly astonished.

40022898.author: Translation
40022898.content: As those two (Lava and Kusha) recited, all the listeners, including Rama, were filled with curiosity and greatly astonished.

40022899.author: पदार्थः
40022899.content: तस्य of that, च and, एव indeed, आगमम् origin, रामः Rama, काव्यस्य of the poem, श्रोतुम् to hear, उत्सुकः eager, पप्रच्छ asked, तौ those two, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, तौ those, उभौ both, मुनिदारकौ sons of the sage.

40022899.author: Translation
40022899.content: The greatly effulgent Rama, eager to hear about the origin of that poem, questioned both those young ascetics.

40022900.author: पदार्थः
40022900.content: किम्प्रमाणम् of what measure, इदम् this, काव्यम् poem, का what, प्रतिष्ठा fame, महात्मनः of the great soul, कर्ता the author, काव्यस्य of the poem, महतः great, क्व where, च and, असौ that, मुनिपुङ्गवः foremost among sages.

40022900.author: Translation
40022900.content: Rama inquired about the length of this poem, the fame of its great author, and the whereabouts of that foremost sage who composed this great work.

40022901.author: पदार्थः
40022901.content: पृच्छन्तम् to the questioning one, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् words, ऊचतुः spoke, मुनिदारकौ the sons of the sage.

40022901.author: Translation
40022901.content: The sons of the sage then spoke words to Rama, who was questioning them.

40022902.author: पदार्थः
40022902.content: वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, भगवान् the revered, कर्ता the author, सम्प्राप्तः has arrived, यज्ञसंविधम् to the sacrificial assembly, येन by whom, इदम् this, चरितम् story, तुभ्यम् to you, अशेषम् completely, सम्प्रदर्शितम् has been shown.

40022902.author: Translation
40022902.content: The revered Valmiki, the author, has arrived at this sacrificial assembly, and it is by him that this entire story has been revealed to you.

40022903.author: पदार्थः
40022903.content: सन्निबद्धं composed, हि indeed, श्लोकानां of verses, चतुर्विशत्सहस्रकम् twenty-four thousand, उपाख्यानशतं a hundred episodes, च and, एव indeed, भार्गवेण by Bhrigu's descendant (Valmiki), तपस्विना by the ascetic.

40022903.author: Translation
40022903.content: This epic, consisting of twenty-four thousand verses and a hundred sub-stories, was indeed composed by the ascetic Valmiki.

40022904.author: पदार्थः
40022904.content: आदिप्रभृति from the beginning, वै indeed, राजन् O King, पञ्चसर्गशतानि five hundred sargas, च and, काण्डानि sections, षट् six, कृतानीह have been made here, सोत्तराणि with the Uttara Kanda, महात्मना by the great soul, कृतानि composed, गुरुणा by the preceptor, अस्माकम् our, ऋषिणा by the sage, चरितं the deeds, तव your.

40022904.author: Translation
40022904.content: O King, from the very beginning, this work, comprising five hundred sargas and six sections including the Uttara Kanda, has been composed here by our great sage and preceptor, detailing your deeds.

40022905.author: पदार्थः
40022905.content: प्रतिष्ठा fame, आजीवितं as long as life, यावत् as long as, तावत् so long, सर्वस्य of everyone, वर्तते exists.

40022905.author: Translation
40022905.content: As long as life exists, so long will the fame of this work endure for everyone.

40022906.author: पदार्थः
40022906.content: सोत्तराणि with the Uttara Kanda, महात्मना by the great soul, यदि if, बुद्धिः intention, कृता made, राजन् O King, श्रवणाय for listening, महारथ O great warrior, कर्मान्तरे in the interval of work, क्षणीभूतः having found a moment, तत् that, शृणुष्व listen, सहानुजः with your younger brothers.

40022906.author: Translation
40022906.content: O King, O great warrior, if you have formed the intention to listen to this work, including the Uttara Kanda, composed by the great soul, then find a moment during your work interval and listen to it with your younger brothers.

40022907.author: पदार्थः
40022907.content: बाढम् certainly, इति thus, अब्रवीत् said, रामः Rama, तौ those two, च and, अनुज्ञाप्य having taken leave, राघवम् from Rama, प्रहृष्टौ delighted, जग्मतुः went, स्थानं to the place, यत्र where, आस्ते resides, मुनिपुङ्गवः the best of sages.

40022907.author: Translation
40022907.content: Rama said, "Certainly," and those two (Kusha and Lava), having taken leave from Rama, went delighted to the place where the best of sages (Valmiki) resided.

40022908.author: पदार्थः
40022908.content: रामो Rama, अपि also, मुनिभिः with sages, सार्धम् together, पार्थिवैः with kings, च and, महात्मभिः great-souled, श्रुत्वा having heard, तत् their, गीतिमाधुर्यम् sweetness of song, कर्मशालाम् to the sacrificial hall, उपागमत् approached.

40022908.author: Translation
40022908.content: Rama, accompanied by great-souled sages and kings, approached the sacrificial hall after hearing the sweetness of their song.

40022909.author: पदार्थः
40022909.content: शुश्राव he heard, तत् that, ताललयोपपन्नम् endowed with rhythm and tempo, सर्गान्वितम् containing cantos, स with, स्वरशब्दयुक्तम् endowed with notes and words, तन्त्रीलयव्यञ्जनयोगयुक्तम् endowed with the harmony of string instruments and clear articulation, कुशीलवाभ्याम् by Kusha and Lava, परिगीयमानम् being sung.

40022909.author: Translation
40022909.content: He heard that song, which was endowed with rhythm and tempo, contained cantos, was rich in notes and words, and harmonized with string instruments and clear articulation, being sung by Kusha and Lava. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुर्नवतितमः सर्गः ।। 94 ।। Thus ends the ninety-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
